method: ran locally; terminal window with real captured curl output (option 3)
notes: The project (ardev-dev/API-progict, Django 3.2.9 + DRF 3.12.4 token auth) serves no page of its own - only JSON endpoints, the stock admin and the stock DRF login - so the picture is a terminal window whose text is a real transcript. A copy ran on Python 3.9 with SQLite (run/todo-api, venv/todo-api) on 127.0.0.1:8132 and the commands in fl/todo-api/session.sh were executed against it with curl + jq; the capture (token already shortened) is session.display.txt. Every line in the image is from that capture: POST /api/account/register (the Arabic success message is the project's own string from account/api/views.py), POST /api/account/login (DRF obtain_auth_token), POST /todos/api/, PUT /todos/api/1/, GET /todos/api/, DELETE /todos/api/3/, and an unauthenticated GET returning 401. Only display edits: the throwaway auth token is cut to its first 8 characters + an ellipsis (session.display.txt), and two extra 'create to-do' calls that ran between the POST and the PUT are not shown (they produce the 2nd and 3rd rows of the list). Sample data: account khalid@example.com and three English task titles; the password is passed as $PW and never shown. Changes confined to the run copy: SECRET_KEY replaced by a dummy, django_heroku replaced by a no-op stand-in module (it needs psycopg2/Heroku), whitenoise static storage line removed. Colours are added by fl/_p3/term.py; no text is added. Doubts: the title bar text ('todo-api - zsh - curl 127.0.0.1:8132') is window chrome I wrote, not captured output. The API insists on 'completed' being sent on create and 'task' on update (the view passes None otherwise), which is why the commands include them.
